name: Baseline: Keep Northampton as main DC
description: Current network, no new capacity: Northampton (DC1) is the national DC, with Daventry (DC2) and Leeds (DC3) as satellites.

name: Second owned DC in the Midlands
description: Build or lease a second owned Midlands DC (shortlist site Daventry Gateway Park) alongside Northampton; takes about 3,500 units a day off DC1 and DC2.

name: Third-party partner DC in the Midlands
description: Keep the current network and add a third-party logistics partner for Midlands and North volume on a 5-year contract; no capex but higher unit handling fees.

name: Close DC2 and consolidate into DC1 and DC3
description: Close the small southern-Midlands DC (Daventry, DC2) and absorb its volume into Northampton (DC1) and Leeds (DC3). Lower rent and labour, longer runs to southern stores, less resilience.

name: Sourcing baseline: southern China
description: Current inbound sourcing: Pearl River Delta factories shipped via Yantian and Shekou to the UK. Network cost lines are unchanged.

name: Diversify to Vietnam and Cambodia
description: Move tariff-exposed volume to Vietnam and Cambodia factories shipped via Cai Mep. Longer qualification and a premium on unit cost, partly offset by lower tariffs. Network cost lines are unchanged.

name: Diversify to India and Bangladesh
description: Move tariff-exposed volume to India and Bangladesh factories shipped via Chittagong and Nhava Sheva. Cheapest labour, longest transit. Network cost lines are unchanged.

name: Nearshore to Turkey and Portugal
description: Move tariff-exposed volume to Turkey and Portugal factories delivered by road and short-sea. Fastest replenishment but a large unit cost premium. Network cost lines are unchanged.
